name: Novelist-Bench
description: Novelist-Bench evaluates language models' ability to generate long-form creative fiction. It measures narrative quality including coherence, plot and character consistency, and stylistic adherence across prompts and genres. Evaluation typically combines automated metrics with human judgements to assess fluency, creativity, and structural coherence.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face benchmark used by researchers focused on long-form narrative generation; modest but growing adoption in creative-generation evaluations.
